AclRelations.title_en: 监听绑定的访问策略组
AclRelations.title_zh: 监听绑定的访问策略组

AclType.description_en:
The type of access control. Valid values:

White: Only requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks settings in the selected access control policy group are forwarded. Whitelists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to allow only specific IP addresses to access your application. Enabling a whitelist poses some risks. After a whitelist is enabled, only the IP addresses in the whitelist can access the load balancing listener.

   If a whitelist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the load balancing listener forwards all requests.

Black: All requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks settings in the selected access control policy group are blocked. Blacklists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to block access from specific IP addresses.

  If a blacklist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the load balancing listener forwards all requests
AclType.description_zh:
访问控制类型。取值：

White：仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于应用只允许特定IP访问的场景。设置白名单存在一定业务风险。一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问负载均衡监听。

   如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

Black：来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的所有请求都不会转发，黑名单适用于应用只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。

  如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求

The original listener and the associated QUIC listener must belong to the same ALB instance, and the QUIC listener must not have been previously associated

RequestTimeout.description_en:
The request timeout period. Unit: seconds.

If the backend server does not provide a response within the timeout period, the load balancing instance stops waiting and returns an `HTTP 504` error code to the client

如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回`HTTP 504`错误码

XForwardedForClientCertClientVerifyAlias.description_en:
The custom header name. This value takes effect only when XForwardedForClientCertClientVerifyEnabled is set to true.

The value must be 1 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter

取值限制：长度为1\~40字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
XForwardedForClientCertClientVerifyAlias.title_en: 自定义HEADER头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertClientVerifyEnabled的值为true的时候，此值才会生效；否则该值不会生效。HTTPS监听有效

XForwardedForClientCertFingerprintEnable.title_en: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Clientcert-fingerprint 头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的指纹取值，HTTPS监听有效。
XForwardedForClientCertFingerprintEnable.title_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Clientcert-fingerprint 头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的指纹取值，HTTPS监听有效。

The value must be 1 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter

取值限制：长度为1\~40字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNAlias.title_en: 自定义HEADER头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled的值为‘On’的时候，此值才会生效；否则该值不会生效。HTTPS监听有效
XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNAlias.title_zh: 自定义HEADER头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled的值为‘On’的时候，此值才会生效；否则该值不会生效。HTTPS监听有效

XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-issuerdn` header field is used to obtain the issuer information of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled.title_en: 是否通过 X-Forwarded-Clientcert-issuerdn 头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的发行者信息。HTTPS监听有效。
XForwardedForClientCertIssuerDNEnabled.title_zh: 是否通过 X-Forwarded-Clientcert-issuerdn 头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的发行者信息。HTTPS监听有效。

XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNAlias.description_en:

The value must be 1 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters a to z, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and digits.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNAlias.description_zh:
自定义头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled的值为true时，此值才会生效。

取值限制：长度为1\~40字符。支持字母a~z、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和数字。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNAlias.title_en: 自定义HEADER头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled的值为true的时候，此值才会生效；否则该值不会生效。HTTPS监听有效
XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNAlias.title_zh: 自定义HEADER头名称，只有当XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled的值为true的时候，此值才会生效；否则该值不会生效。HTTPS监听有效

XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Forwarded-Clientcert-subjectdn` header field is used to obtain the owner information of the client certificate that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Clientcert-subjectdn`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的所有者信息。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTPS监听支持此参数
XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled.title_en: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Clientcert-subjectdn  头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的所有者信息。HTTPS监听有效。
XForwardedForClientCertSubjectDNEnabled.title_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Clientcert-subjectdn  头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端证书的所有者信息。HTTPS监听有效。

XForwardedForClientSourceIpsEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether ALB is allowed to look up the originating client IP address from the X-Forwarded-For header field. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No.

HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForClientSourceIpsEnabled.description_zh:
是否允许ALB从X-Forwarded-For头字段中查找真实客户端IP。取值：

true：是。
false：否。

HTTP、HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForClientSourceIpsTrusted.description_en:
The trusted proxy IP addresses.

Application Load Balancer (ALB) traverses the `X-Forwarded-For` header from right to left and selects the first IP address that is not in the trusted IP list as the originating client IP address. This IP address is used for source IP-based rate limiting
XForwardedForClientSourceIpsTrusted.description_zh:
指定可信的代理IP。

应用型负载均衡ALB会从后往前遍历`X-Forwarded-For`，选取第一个不在可信IP列表中的IP作为真实的客户端IP，该IP会被用于源IP限速

XForwardedForClientSrcPortEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Forwarded-Client-Port` header field is used to obtain the port of the client that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.

HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForClientSrcPortEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Client-Port`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的端口。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
XForwardedForClientSrcPortEnabled.title_en: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Client-Port 头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的端口。HTTPS监听有效。
XForwardedForClientSrcPortEnabled.title_zh: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Client-Port 头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的端口。HTTPS监听有效。

XForwardedForEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Forwarded-For` header field is used to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:
true (default): Yes.
false: No.

If set to true, XForwardedForProcessingMode defaults to append and can be changed to remove.
If set to false, the `X-Forwarded-For` header field is preserved without additional processing before the request is sent to the backend server.
HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-For`头字段获取来访者真实IP。取值：
true（默认值）：是。
false：否。

配置true，XForwardedForProcessingMode默认取值append，支持修改为remove。
配置false，将请求发送至后端服务之前保留`X-Forwarded-For`头字段，不做额外处理。
HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
XForwardedForEnabled.title_en: 是否开启通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取来访者真实 IP
XForwardedForEnabled.title_zh: 是否开启通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取来访者真实 IP

XForwardedForHostEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Forwarded-Host` header field is used to obtain the domain name of the client that accesses the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false (default): No.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForHostEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启通过`X-Forwarded-Host`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的域名。取值：
true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数

XForwardedForProcessingMode.description_en:
The mode for processing the `X-Forwarded-For` header field. This value takes effect only when XForwardedForEnabled is set to true. Valid values:
append (default): Append.
remove: Remove.

If set to append, the last-hop IP address is appended to the `X-Forwarded-For` header field before the request is sent to the backend server.
If set to remove, the `X-Forwarded-For` header is removed before the request is sent to the backend server, regardless of whether the request contains the `X-Forwarded-For` header field.
HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForProcessingMode.description_zh:
处理`X-Forwarded-For`头字段的模式。只有当XForwardedForEnabled为true时，此值才会生效。取值：
append（默认值）：附加。
remove：删除。

配置append，将请求发送至后端服务之前把最后一跳IP加入`X-Forwarded-For`头字段。
配置remove，将请求发送至后端服务之前删除`X-Forwarded-For`标头，无论请求是否携带`X-Forwarded-For`头字段。
HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForProtoEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header field is used to obtain the listener protocol of the load balancing instance. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.

HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForProtoEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Proto`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

HTTP、HTTPS和QUIC监听支持此参数
XForwardedForProtoEnabled.title_en: 是否通过X-Forwarded-Proto头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议。
